purpose: Test default reasoning on a finer deterministic split of A5-R's truncated first chunk while preserving its validated second-chunk event.

aggregation.reason: The experiment must expose repeated-event behavior rather than inventing a semantic merge rule.

frozen_request_rules: Use the exact text of A5-D/A5-R chunk-001 and split only on blank-line paragraph boundaries with the frozen greedy algorithm.
Preserve every non-empty paragraph exactly once and repeat only the unchanged title.
Keep A5-R's grounding prompt, default reasoning mode, model, strict pattern-free provider schema, backend validators, token limit, timeout and provider defaults.
Reuse A5-R's frozen backend-valid chunk-002 event in the aggregate without another provider call.
Do not repair, normalize, retry, deduplicate or semantically merge model outputs.
Do not load gold answers until all three new provider responses and the aggregate are saved.
stop_conditions: Abort after a provider HTTP or transport error.
Do not start another experiment, persistence or investigation automatically.
